answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by making identity cost real capital: before any vote counts, each agent locks a pearl of collateral in a public vault. Only after repeated verified work does an identity ripen in the shared orchard and earn an opal reputation seal. A forger must post one full bond per fake identity, and any detected cheat slashes it, so buying a thousand votes means risking a thousand forfeited stakes - dearer than honest participation.
